title: Prepare native Windows SDK and guarded SP/MP execution
goal: Build the pinned selected SDK with a capable native Windows compiler and execute the verified guarded modules without weakening host security.
acceptance: Pin compiler, headers/import libraries, transitive sources and configuration; use isolated outputs and reproducible preparation evidence
Compile the task-036 guarded harness and verified generated modules; verify bindings and reproduce the bounded SP/MP checkpoints without claiming playable boot
Keep SDK/game binaries private, preserve security settings and record blocked tools rather than bypassing antivirus; coordinate any shared preparation-driver changes separately
validation: Run Windows native positive/negative host fixtures and three independent guarded startup attempts per title
Compare import results/stops with Linux evidence and record platform divergences, unsupported checks and actual artifacts
